drafter.private_reasoning: We should advance the draft without disclosing the client’s internal floor. Best approach is to tighten the agreement, add standard protections (mutual release, no disparagement, tax cooperation, execution counterpart language), and leave the payment figure as a placeholder for now. The cover note should sound cooperative and commercially practical, inviting the other side to populate the number and confirm timing/administrative details.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for circulating the first draft. We’ve made a few market-standard edits to make the agreement more complete and efficient to paper, including clarifying the payment mechanics, converting the release to a mutual release, and adding customary confidentiality / non-disparagement and tax-cooperation language. We left the dollar figure as a placeholder for the moment—once your side confirms the settlement payment amount and timing, we can turn the final quickly.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims, disputes, and potential claims between them, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action.
edits.name: Expand recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to counsel for Plaintiff, subject to delivery of a completed W-9 and wire instructions.
edits.name: Clarify payment mechanics

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, each party, on behalf of itself and its affiliates, predecessors, successors, officers, directors, employees, agents, and insurers, releases and forever discharges the other party and its related persons from any and all claims, demands, liabilities, damages, costs, and causes of action of any kind, known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action, except for obligations expressly created by this Agreement.
edits.name: Mutual release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement, including the fact and amount of settlement, are strictly confidential, except as required by law, court order, or for disclosure to a party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, or immediate family members on a need-to-know basis who are informed of and agree to be bound by this confidentiality obligation.
edits.name: Confidentiality carveouts

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, and neither this Agreement nor the fact of settlement may be used as evidence except to enforce its terms.
edits.name: No admission clarification

edits.text: Please insert the settlement payment amount and confirm whether payment will be made within 10 business days or another business-day window your client prefers.
edits.name: Payment placeholder comment

edits.text: This Confidential Settlement Agreement is entered into by and between Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar.
edits.name: Introductory sentence

edits.text: 5. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree not to make any false, disparaging, or derogatory statements about one another concerning the matters resolved by this Agreement, except as required by law.
edits.name: Add non-disparagement

edits.text: 6. TAXES. Each party shall be responsible for its own taxes arising from this Agreement, and the parties shall reasonably cooperate in connection with any required tax reporting.
edits.name: Add tax provision

edits.text: 7. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter hereof and may be executed in counterparts, each of which will be deemed an original.

drafter.private_reasoning: Opposing counsel is prepared to move on timing and asks for the amount. I can concede the payment timing to 5 business days to keep momentum, but I should not disclose the client’s confidential floor absent instruction. Best course is to confirm that payment timing is accepted while stating that the settlement amount remains under review and can be provided in a follow-up/clean version once internal approval is complete.
